name: no-evasion-markers
message: test skips, expects failure or retries instead of passing ({match})

remediation.root_cause: A skip, expected-failure or retry marker lets a failing or flaky test count as handled instead of fixed.
remediation.fix: Remove the marker and fix the code or test so it passes on every required run; record a reason-backed exceptions entry only for an external outage.

name: no-self-mocking-assignments
message: test replaces an attribute of the repo's own code ({target})

remediation.root_cause: The test rebinds an attribute of owned code, so it checks the replacement rather than the code that ships.
remediation.fix: Drive the behaviour through the declared public entry point and give the owned dependency an interface the test can pass a real or fake implementation through.

name: no-self-mocking-calls
message: test patches or mocks the repo's own code ({target})

remediation.root_cause: The test patches owned code because the code under test reaches its collaborator directly instead of receiving it.
remediation.fix: Inject the collaborator through an owned interface, fake only third-party or OS boundaries, and call the public entry point unchanged.

name: no-self-mocking-specs
message: test builds a mock of the repo's own code ({target})

remediation.root_cause: The test builds a mock specced on owned code, which copies the owned interface instead of exercising it.
remediation.fix: Use the real owned object through the public entry point and fake only third-party or OS boundaries behind owned interfaces.

name: no-test-hooks-environment
message: production code reads a test marker from the environment or loaded modules ({match})

remediation.root_cause: Production code reads a test marker from the environment or loaded modules, so it behaves differently while tests run.
remediation.fix: Delete the marker read and make the varying behaviour a production input, such as configuration or an injected dependency, that tests set like any caller.

name: no-test-hooks-names
message: production code declares a test-only hook ({match})

remediation.root_cause: Production code declares a hook named for tests, which exists only to let tests reach inside.
remediation.fix: Remove the hook and drive the behaviour through the public entry point, exposing a real production input where tests need control.

name: property-seed
message: Hypothesis property test neither fixes nor reports its seed ({match})

remediation.root_cause: The Hypothesis property test runs with a seed that is neither fixed nor reported, so a failure cannot be replayed.
remediation.fix: Fix or report the seed for every property test through a shared Hypothesis settings profile: @seed, print_blob=True or derandomize=True.
